subject: Update redis* to valkey* in syscheck.c (#365)
reason: The change only edits human-readable warning text in syscheck.c (renaming 'redis-server'/'Redis' to 'valkey-server'/'Valkey' in the xen clocksource and THP startup advisories). No logic, return codes, replies, persistence or replication behaviour changes, so there is nothing a scenario could exercise or compare.
